question.text: The correct graph representation of potential along the branch PQRS is

solution.text: As we move from <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math> to <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> we are moving from high potential to low potential. Since <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math> is connected to +<math><mi mathvariant="normal">v</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></math> terminal of battery it should be at a positive potential. <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></math> is grounded hence it should be at zero potential. <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> should be at a negative potential.
